definitions.short: Abiram , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H48. Abiram אֲבִירָם proper name, masculine ( (the) Exalted One is (my) father (see Bae Rel 156 ) compare Assyrian Aburamu (?) KAT 2479 compare Dl L2, p. 91, 1. 225 ). 1 a Reubenite, son of Eliab Num 16:1 , 12 , 24 , 25 , 27 (twice in verse); 26:9 ; Deut 11:6 ; Psa 106:17 . 2 son of Hiel the Bethelite 1Kin 16:34 . compare also following.
definitions.rootNote: from 1 and 7311 ; father of height (i.e. lofty);
